title: rubus costatus var. tomentosus
intro: Rubus costatus var. tomentosus, commonly known as Himalayan raspberry or Himalayan raspberry leaf, is a plant species belonging to the family Rosaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as lowering blood pressure and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Rubus costatus var. tomentosus include acting as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic, which help in relieving menstrual cramps, reducing swelling, and promoting urination. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
